jobDescription: The ads ranking team builds the models that order sponsored results on the company's search and feed surfaces. The Machine Learning Scientist leads the modelling work on the auction-aware ranking models: sets the modelling approach, signs the experiment analysis plans that the ads leadership acts on, reviews the other scientists' model changes, and documents each model's limitations. The team requires a PhD in machine learning, statistics or a related field, because the scientist signs the analysis plans that leadership acts on. Reports to the head of ads science; works with the ads engineering teams, the experimentation platform team and ads leadership.
requirements: Holds a PhD in machine learning, statistics or a related field.
Has signed experiment analysis plans that leadership acted on.
Sets the modelling approach for auction-aware ranking models and reviews other scientists' model changes.
Runs model experiments under the team's documented analysis standard.
Documents each model's limitations and the boundaries of each experiment's conclusions.

evidence.text: Machine Learning Scientist on the ads ranking team of a consumer internet company for five years, leading the modelling work on the auction-aware ranking models and signing the experiment analysis plans that ads leadership acted on; the signed plans are in the experiment registry.
Education: PhD in Statistics, 2020, thesis on counterfactual evaluation of ranking policies; MSc Statistics, 2016.
Set the modelling approach for the three auction-aware ranking model generations shipped in that period and reviewed the other four scientists' model changes as the team's model reviewer.
Ran the model experiments under the team's analysis standard, with the analysis notebooks and the experiment registry entries carrying my name as analyst.
Wrote the limitation section of each model's documentation and the conclusion boundary section of each experiment report.

Work sample: two signed experiment analysis plans from the experiment registry, one model documentation with its limitation section, and the PhD certificate, with the registry identifiers as a verification trail.
Recruiter screen: candidate said she holds a PhD in Statistics and signs the analysis plans as the team's lead scientist; the thesis topic and the registry role she described match the resume.
Hiring manager pre-read: the head of ads science asks that the packet cite the signed plans by registry identifier and the PhD certificate.
